- High-temperature dielectric films need higher permittivity with low loss while keeping polymer strength and thermal stability
- BST core carrying an MPTMS thiol layer decorated with Ag nanoparticles, used as hybrid filler

- MPTMS chains are covalently grafted on the BST particle surface (Si-O and CH2 groups present)
- Interfacial adhesion, insulating MPTMS shell and Ag Coulomb blockade restrict dipole motion and space-charge build-up, suppressing loss
- Dielectric loss stays low (text: <0.026), increasing only slightly with Ag content

key.answer_key: No. On the BST@Ag1% curve in F6b, loss climbs above 100 kHz and reaches about 0.065 at 1 MHz, and low-frequency losses already exceed 0.026 (o16).
